name: ListTemplates

parameters.help_en: The template name. All templates whose names contain the specified template name are returned
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称。列出含所填模板名称的所有模板
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The template format. Valid values:
JSON
YAML
parameters.help_zh:
模板格式。取值范围：
JSON
YAML
parameters.name: template_format

parameters.help_en:
The share type. Valid values:
Public
Private
parameters.help_zh:
分享类型。取值范围：
Public
Private
parameters.name: share_type

parameters.help_en:
The creator of the template.
For official templates provided by Alibaba Cloud, the value is ACS.
For templates created by users, you can specify a UID or a username to filter templates
parameters.help_zh:
模板创建者。
对于阿里云官方提供的模板，为ACS
对于用户个人创建的模板，可填写 UID 进行筛选，或填写 用户名称 进行筛选
parameters.name: created_by

parameters.help_en:
Filters templates whose creation time is earlier than or equal to the specified time.

Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间小于等于指定时间的模板。


格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm::ssZ
parameters.name: created_date_before

parameters.help_en:
Filters templates whose creation time is later than or equal to the specified time.

Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间大于等于指定时间的模板。

格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: created_date_after

parameters.help_en: The tags in key-value pairs. The number of key-value pairs ranges from 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 标签键及值，键值对数量限制为1至20
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The template category, such as TimerTrigger, EventTrigger, AlarmTrigger, or Other
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：10-100。默认为50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. This value is obtained from the response of the current page if more results are available
parameters.help_zh: 对查询结果进行翻页时需要传入的Token值，如有则获取自当前页的返回值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The field used to sort the query results. Valid values:

TotalExecutionCount (default): total number of executions
Popularity: popularity
TemplateName: template name
CreatedDate: creation time
UpdatedDate: update time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。取值范围：

TotalExecutionCount（默认值）：总执行次数
Popularity：受欢迎程度
TemplateName：模板名称
CreatedDate：创建时间
UpdatedDate：更新时间
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

Ascending: ascending order
Descending (default): descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：

Ascending：升序
Descending（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the template has a trigger
parameters.name: has_trigger

parameters.help_en:
The template type. Valid values:
Automation: automation
State: configuration inventory
Package: software package
parameters.help_zh:
模版类型：
Automation：自动化
State：配置清单
Package：软件包
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the template is added to favorites
parameters.name: is_favorite

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the template is an example template
parameters.name: is_example

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. This value is obtained from the response of the current page if more results are available
NextToken.description_zh: 对查询结果进行翻页时需要传入的Token值，如有则获取自当前页的返回值

CreatedDate.description_en: The time when the template was created

HasTrigger.description_en: Indicates whether the template was successfully triggered

Hash.description_en: The SHA-256 hash of the template content

IsFavorite.description_en: Specifies whether the template is added to favorites

Popularity.description_en:
The popularity of the public template. The value ranges from 1 to 10. A higher value indicates greater popularity. If ShareType is Private, the value of this field is `-1`.

This field is meaningful only when ShareType is Public
Popularity.description_zh:
公共模板受欢迎程度。范围是1-10，数字越高表示越受欢迎。若ShareType为Private，该字段值为`-1`。

该字段在ShareType为Public时有意义

ShareType.description_en:
The share type of the template. Templates created by users have a share type of Private. Valid values:

Public
Private
ShareType.description_zh:
模板共享类型。目前用户创建的模板的共享类型均为 Private。取值范围：

Public
Private

Tags.description_en: The tags in key-value pairs. The number of key-value pairs ranges from 1 to 20
Tags.description_zh: 标签键及值，键值对数量限制为1至20

TemplateFormat.description_en: The template format. The system determines the format, which is JSON or YAML
TemplateFormat.description_zh: 模板格式。系统字段判断，为JSON或YAML

TemplateVersion.description_en: The template version, in the format of "v" followed by a number starting from 1
TemplateVersion.description_zh: 模板版本。以“v”+数字的形式，数字从1开始

TotalExecutionCount.description_en:
The total number of executions for the private template. If ShareType is Public, the value of this field is `-1`.

This field is meaningful only when ShareType is Private
TotalExecutionCount.description_zh:
私有模板总执行次数。若ShareType为Public，该字段值为`-1`。

该字段在ShareType为Private时有意义

UpdatedBy.description_en: The user who last updated the template

UpdatedDate.description_en: The time when the template was last updated
